images.prompt: Create one wide PNG illustration approximately16:9, native around1672x941. Friendly clear abstract comic biology style, soft sunny background, clean outlines, fits existing school goal images. Main relationships must remain recognizable at360px and680px widths. At most three large short German labels, no small paragraphs. No photorealism, no sterile technical infographic, no unrelated decorations, no notebook text. Scientifically accurate schematic, no medical instructions or actual patient data. Show the constituents of human blood in a generous illustrated magnifying window emerging from a small capped blood sample tube. Many large red biconcave erythrocytes WITHOUT nuclei float in pale yellow liquid; one much larger purple-white leucocyte has a clearly visible lobed nucleus; a few much smaller irregular violet platelet cell fragments are distinct from whole cells. No faces inside cells. RBCs should visibly look like discs with central depressions, not nucleated balls. The background liquid represents plasma. Use only three large clear labels "Erythrozyten", "Leukozyt", "Thrombozyten", with unmistakable short leader lines to the correct types. The liquid background and tube communicate fluid without a fourth tiny label. Do not draw separate serum/plasma stages or unexplained percentage scales.

wholeGoal.title: Bau des Blutes
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Blutbestandteile benennen und Eigenschaften beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can name blood components and describe their properties.

Show three broad adjacent schematic vignettes for functions of human blood: left a red biconcave blood cell transports a few tiny blue oxygen bubbles marked with the single large label "Transport"; middle a clean non-gory cross-section of a small vessel wall has a small tear sealed by a pale mesh with clustered small purple platelet fragments, large label "Gerinnung"; right one large leucocyte approaches a few clearly distinct bacterial rods, large label "Abwehr". wholeGoal.title: Funktionen der Blutbestandteile
wholeGoal.titleEn: Functions of Blood Cells and Plasma
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Funktionen von Blutzellen und Plasma für Transport, Gerinnung und Immunität erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain functions of blood cells and plasma for transport, clotting, and immunity.

images.prompt: Create one wide PNG illustration approximately16:9, native around1672x941. Friendly clear abstract comic biology style, soft sunny background, clean outlines, fits existing school goal images. Main relationships must remain recognizable at360px and680px widths. At most three large short German labels, no small paragraphs. No photorealism, no sterile technical infographic, no unrelated decorations, no notebook text. Scientifically accurate schematic, no medical instructions or actual patient data. Illustrate one simplified ABO incompatibility mechanism specifically for RED BLOOD CELLS, NOT plasma units or universal donor instructions. A large left circular inset contains recipient blood of group A: red biconcave cells with small ROUND orange A antigen shapes on membranes, with free blue Y-shaped antibodies in the surrounding plasma. A right circular inset shows foreign group B red cells with SQUARE purple B antigen shapes. Some of those same blue Y-shaped anti-B antibodies specifically bind the square B antigens and bridge two or three B red cells into a visible cluster. They do NOT bind recipient's round A markers. Large labels only "A", "Anti-B", "B". Keep arrows/leaders simple and antibodies clearly outside cells. Distinct antigen shapes AND colors, no A marker on B cells, no RhD, no blood-transfusion apparatus. The main concept is antibody-specific incompatibility, not a complete clinical decision rule.

wholeGoal.title: Blutgruppen verstehen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann AB0- und Rhesus-System erläutern und bei Transfusion berücksichtigen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the ABO and Rhesus systems and consider them in transfusion contexts.

At most three large short German labels, no small paragraphs. No photorealism, no sterile technical infographic, no unrelated decorations, no notebook text. Scientifically accurate schematic, no medical instructions or actual patient data. Show a clean friendly immune-recognition comparison in two large panels. Left label "Infektion": a large purple leucocyte with nucleus and a small T-cell recognise clearly foreign green bacterial rods; some bacteria enclosed in a leucocyte phagocytic vesicle. Right label "Transplantat": a different healthy tan tissue-cell cluster is framed as foreign donor tissue; a purple T-cell touches one donor cell surface and initiates an immune reaction. A small neutral shield icon between panels indicates recognition/defence. Distinguish normal donor tissue from microbial rods. Do not label tissue infected, do not show medication, surgery, gore, actual organ operation, or imply a graft is literally a bacterium. Conceptual immune defence can protect against infection and also reject foreign transplanted tissue.

wholeGoal.title: Immunabwehr beschreiben
wholeGoal.titleEn: Immune Responses in Infection and Transplantation
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Immunreaktionen bei Infektionen und Transplantationen beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe immune responses in infections and transplantations.

images.prompt: Create one wide PNG illustration approximately16:9, native around1672x941. Friendly clear abstract comic biology style, soft sunny background, clean outlines, fits existing school goal images. Main relationships must remain recognizable at360px and680px widths. At most three large short German labels, no small paragraphs. No photorealism, no sterile technical infographic, no unrelated decorations, no notebook text. Scientifically accurate schematic, no medical instructions or actual patient data. Create a friendly clear microscopic schematic of HIV affecting a CD4 helper T cell, with a modest treatment comparison. A large teal-blue round lymphocyte with a nucleus occupies the left; a few purple HIV particles with envelope surface spikes are near its membrane. One enlarged receptor site shows a virus approaching the cell; large labels "HIV" and "CD4-Zelle" point unmistakably to virus and cell respectively. On the right, a simple treatment shield labelled "Therapie" blocks an outgoing replication pathway, shown by a stopped arrow before it can create a cloud of new viral particles. Retain one small virus motif inside the cell so treatment does NOT imply eradication or cure. No dead people, moral stereotypes, risky contact illustrations, alarmist skulls, or needle instructions. No route-specific U=U claim in this image. Cells have no faces. The image illustrates virus-target-cell and treatment-controlled replication, not a full molecular mechanism.

wholeGoal.title: HIV und AIDS einordnen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann HIV-Infektion und AIDS erklären und Präventionsaspekte darstellen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain HIV infection and AIDS and present prevention aspects.
